text: After a horrible car accident beside [the Km. 31 marker|rules|tied to place or thing] on a rural wooded road near Mexico City, Agata falls into a coma, and her identical twin Catalina begins to feel her pain and terror. Searching for the truth of the crash, Catalina uncovers [a local legend|origin|old beliefs and legends] of malignant spirits that prowl the road and [prey on travellers|who_suffers|newcomers and travellers]. With her boyfriend Nuño, Agata's boyfriend Omar and detective Martin Ugalde, she learns that her sister is trapped between life and death, in [a netherworld of evil spirits|threat|the restless dead].
